[spoiler=Serafinism part 1] A man shows who he is in three ways: his appetite, his relationship to money, and his anger. Serifinism concerns religion with a persons relationship to money, or the pocket and how they show themselves in dealing with others and the world. In all pockets, questions related to excess, survival and insecurity arise. A certain religious aphorism goes The longest path is the one that leads from the heart to the pocket. We cant get from either to the other and avoid observing life around us and all the influences we have on it. How we see our pocket shows who we are and where we are in the Market of Values (reality) that we live in. This market sees exchanges of all sorts and is where we source our concept of economic markets. It shows the infinite number of small and great exchanges that happen in the universe at any time. These deals and exchanges are made through the use of an immense diversity of currencies. These currencies that can be compared to our own in everyday life and those of nations are the main focus of Serafinism.
	
	Above considerations of good and evil, our lives are shown by the ever-constant change of our intentions as they are received by others and reality itself. Our abilities to form experience into tradition and culture allow our children to compare to a fixed body of morals and ethics that they can develop, critique, and improve upon. This leads us to our knowledge of our humanity and relations in the Market. Culture, in a way, creates a desire for its own collapse. The reveal of theological ideas of right and wrong, building up and collapsing downward. Many imagine the politician who takes kickbacks from companies, the policeman who turns a blind eye for an amount going to himself, and the minister who commits crimes after preaching about how those in his hall should do no wrong. The wish to reveal that of which we wish to be hypocritical reveals how we want to see those whose responsibility it is to challenge our animalistic instincts and reactions. 
[/spoiler]
